body:
# Turning Ravine production slice: 3 October 2026

Owner: dedicated Codex builder. State: IN_PROGRESS. Authority: scrum-QA-01-recovery-review-20261003.md accepts the scoped private development dependency gate; Sam's authorised original redesign continues. Child/device/Sam usability, QA-02 and public release remain open.

Exact files claimed before writes: new `expeditions/v2/generation/turning-ravine.js`, `turning-ravine.test.js`, new `expeditions/v2/ui/RotationBoard.jsx` and rotation UI checks; existing `generation/topology.js` for an explicit reserved-footprint option used only by the new family; `puzzles/rotation.js` for exact arithmetic and independent solver evidence as needed; `ui/MapViewport.jsx`, `PuzzlePanel.jsx`, `OrchardExpedition.jsx`, `Briefing.jsx`, `action-guide.js`, `next-step.js`, `PuzzleNote.jsx` for truthful family instruction and in-grid controls; `art/EquationWheel.jsx` and related wheel tests for engine-consistent orientation. New bounded Turning Ravine certification/preview tools and evidence under `docs/expeditions/v2/evidence/turning-ravine-20261003/`. Existing planner/core/schema/action/phase files are initially read-only; report ABI gaps rather than inventing a second engine. Historical banks and artifacts remain intact. Runtime generation selection will not be expanded before actual mission certification and review.

First delivery: T1, six variable wheels (four number, two operator), three adjacent five-token tracks, shared numbers, one effective full solution, exact six operator faces and free draft/paid activation. Keep all printed stats, costs, pressure, commissioning and alternative alcove rules. Consume the real reducer/planner for two direct target-band plans and a separate feasible alcove route. Then advance remaining tiers and already approved dependencies in order. Shared HTML outputs require final-build.

Additional exact claims before edits: `ui/feedback.js`, `ui/MissionSetup.jsx` and `ui/ActionPreview.jsx` for wheel-specific names, rewind consequences and family-aware setup/action copy. No new shared core interface is required. T1 hedges/seed1 currently has31/33/34-command verified wins at round5; the Bushel/Dapple/Pip alcove search exhausted80000states and is retained as unknown. Tuppence/Dapple/Sorrel succeeds in3696states. River/seed1 also constructs a valid puzzle/topology. Islands and terraces still reject the current bounded footprint patterns: they are not runtime-ready and no barrier rule is relaxed.

Additional claim: `ui/station-state.js` so a schema-valid scrambled rotation draft does not incorrectly label an unactivated control as active. Existing component wheel rotation convention is preserved; the new board passes negative engine orientation into that artwork adapter, with explicit top-notch/active-face tests.

## Verified reference handoff: 4 October 2026

T1_REFERENCE_READY_FOR_REVIEW; overall IN_PROGRESS. This is a working, independently verified reference slice, not a completed runtime bank, pixel approval, device approval or child/Sam comprehension acceptance. TURNING-RAVINE-20261003 remains owned while authorised generator/art work continues. final-build was held during the successful shared build and is released after this report.

The seed1/hedges blueprint is deterministic, schema-valid and retains content hash `64f9c5ecff18e81f`. It has four number wheels, two exact six-face operator wheels and three adjacent five-token tracks, sharing B and C. All-wheel independent BigInt enumeration examines46656 settings and proves exactly one full solution. Four Locks pinned maths hashes, existing topology and all production rule checks pass. Ordinary runtime availability still exposes only the previously certified Four Locks slice.

Real planner/reducer evidence: Tuppence/Furrow/Sorrel direct31commands, Bushel/Wicker/Pip alternative direct33commands with a different circuit pair and Tuppence/Dapple/Sorrel alcove34commands. All win at round5 and all retained per-command hashes reproduce. The separately retained failed Bushel/Dapple/Pip80000-state search remains unknown, never promoted to proof.

Actual private controller UI evidence: began from zero commands in disposable QA progress, turned shared B once through battlefield controls, used free worked help, activated at the control, restored wind changes, charged/held all jobs and defeated Crosswind. Won round5 with32commands, final hash `97b59e6c4663c5d5`, awarded3first-clear stars. `ui-winning-trace.json` is an actual exported UI record. It contains a final hash, not live per-command hashes; the verifier derives and stores replay hashes explicitly labelled as derived. `ui-shared-wheel-trace.json` independently proves the free edit leaves all hero AP2 and committed outputs off. No winning state was injected into the live preview and no original profile/save was modified.

Executable verification: `node scripts/dev/verify-turning-ravine-evidence.mjs`; `node --test expeditions/v2/generation/turning-ravine.test.js`; `node --test scripts/dev/test-turning-ravine-ui.mjs scripts/dev/test-orchard-wheel.mjs`; affected UI/visual checks12/12passed; full `npm test`25/25steps passed, including the complete v2 suite, rebuild and bundle smoke. The initial interrupted scoped run recorded206/208passes, an interrupted Back timeout and a genuine absent-ID feedback exception. The feedback predicate was repaired and the final full suite is green. Preserve `scoped-tests.log` and `full-regression.log` as interrupted evidence; the authoritative completed log is `full-regression-20261004.log`.

Both `WallabyMaths.html` and `www/index.html`: rebuild reported101555038characters, SHA256 `2602ff6f3c9c93c44bdf3f9d683e1dd433197ed7564ad7b4cd56bfacc2f4d5a7`. Deployment was not performed.

Capture provenance: earlier3October Page.captureScreenshot timed out. On4October the old servers/processes were absent, verified before another build. The bounded workspace-only server was restored at localhost8755. Actual documented browser capture now succeeds: `visual-retry-20261004.png` plus phone390×844, tablet768×1024 and desktop1280×720 at overview, native and maximum camera scale, nine PNGs and corresponding DOM snapshots. `responsive-capture-results-20261004.json` lists outcomes; temporary viewport override was reset. These are browser viewport checks, not physical device evidence. All nine images were inspected. Active glyphs/notches are upright and clear at native/maximum; overview is for navigation and the rail exposes exact readings. Phone rail scroll is necessary for linked equations below the rotation buttons. Checklist/Find controls occlude portions of the board at some zooms; camera panning remains necessary.

Visual gaps observed in actual pixels: Crosswind currently falls back to a circle marked Cr; Ravine stations currently use generic code glyphs rather than final family identities. Production reference artwork integration is the next bounded C10 dependency. No final visual acceptance is asserted. Existing Crosswind idle/defeated candidates have now been inspected on white, black, orchard green, cyan and48/96/192scale sheets; their disconnected leaf particles are intentional, not licence to remove components or relax alpha thresholds. No new bitmap batch is justified.

Remaining generator gates: islands/terraces bounded footprint/topology attempts reject; higher Ravine tiers are explicit unknown; present six incidence templates and raw-ID fingerprint do not establish eight canonical dependency patterns or a64-entry bank. Those remain generation work, followed by independent tactical certification before any runtime promotion. No enemy, station integrity, deadline, charge, stat, reward or private-access rule was weakened.

Source provenance for this slice: `generation/turning-ravine.js`, `generation/turning-ravine.test.js`, the explicit reserved-footprint extension in `generation/topology.js`, exact rational evaluation in `puzzles/rotation.js`, new `ui/RotationBoard.jsx`, wheel-null accessibility label in `art/EquationWheel.jsx`, family-aware `ui/MapViewport.jsx`, `OrchardExpedition.jsx`, `PuzzlePanel.jsx`, `PuzzleNote.jsx`, `Briefing.jsx`, `action-guide.js`, `next-step.js`, `station-state.js` and `feedback.js`. `MissionSetup.jsx` and `ActionPreview.jsx` were claimed for possible follow-on copy but not edited in this reference slice. New dev-only certification, UI checks, preview builder/source and independent evidence verifier are under `scripts/dev`; review evidence is only under `docs/expeditions/v2/evidence/turning-ravine-20261003`. Historical banks/artifacts and the original recovery saves are retained.

## Final legacy batch and release: 4 October 2026

Originating thread `01a100e6-b8f7-7a73-97c8-afa8455b7120`; mailbox actor codex, subject prefix LEGACY. Follow `scrum-overnight-handoff-20261004.md`: Claude takes generation/topology/planner/banks/core/final integration, new Codex coding takes UI/puzzles and new Codex art takes art/imports/resolver. This builder finishes this bounded batch, releases both claims and takes no additional implementation. No cleanup, reset, migration, deployment or original-save deletion is part of the handoff.

Crosswind gap resolved in this batch by selecting two existing exact-hash assets, not generating replacements. Added `enemy-crosswind-idle` SHA256 `075712b7d5108794dacef16c4ae88634087974e1c4505da1f6491b56eb9637bb` and `enemy-crosswind-defeated` SHA256 `9556abcfbc626b0c538e81e5459e67f146b1f9b1b155f170104fd7c72364902d`. Narrow claim: `scripts/dev/embed-orchard-v2-art.cjs`, `docs/expeditions/v2/art-preflight-review.json`, `expeditions/v2/art/runtime-art.js`, `manifest.json` and `art.test.js`. Selected registry now55assets/1472186bytes. Resolver already requests these IDs; no resolver rewrite, alpha relaxation or source-image modification. Exact detached-leaf review recorded in the preflight JSON. Defeated selection is verified by resolver tests and isolated four-background art review, not a new live defeated-board capture.

Rebuilt isolated reference preview after the feedback fix and Crosswind import. Actual live `crosswind-import-live-20261004.png` and nine `crosswind-{phone|tablet|desktop}-{overview|native|maximum}-20261004.png` captures retain the updated import. Focused maximum `crosswind-board-maximum-20261004.png` shows its intact upright wind silhouette, leaf particles and hex contact. The preceding focused drawer image is intentionally kept as occlusion evidence. Temporary viewport overrides are reset. These screenshots establish browser rendering evidence, not physical-device/Sam/child acceptance. Station glyph identities remain unfinished for Codex art/coding to coordinate. No station replacement was started after the boundary change.

Final executable results after the import: `node --test scripts/dev/test-turning-ravine-ui.mjs expeditions/v2/art/art.test.js`10/10pass. Added regression asserts the ravine-wind damage names its cause and missing optional IDs cannot access a missing puzzle. Final `node scripts/rebuild.cjs` and `node scripts/bundle_smoke.cjs` pass: root populated, no runtime errors. The earlier full `npm test`25/25pass was before the two Crosswind art imports and added feedback test; it is not mislabelled as a second final full-suite run. Final scoped art tests, unchanged reducer proofs and final build/smoke cover that bounded follow-on.

Final shared outputs supersede the prior build hash above: both101642984actual UTF-8bytes (the rebuild reports101642965characters), SHA256 `286e57bc2cd51b5c53635714092959f9c731aff7372288002638bc57eed75707`. Final logs: `final-art-feedback-tests-20261004.log`, `final-crosswind-rebuild-20261004.log`, `final-crosswind-smoke-20261004.log`. Machine-readable source/evidence/build provenance: `handoff-provenance-20261004.json`, generated by `scripts/dev/snapshot-turning-ravine-handoff.mjs` before releasing ownership. It snapshots current file contents, not a clean Git diff; the checkout already contains unrelated dirty work.

Ready review packet is the T1 deterministic reference, independent maths, three physical-route reducer proofs, actual32-command UI win/reward export, orientation/free-edit tests and responsive browser screenshots. Unfinished production gates are canonical incidence diversity, four-layout coverage, all remaining tiers, complete certified seed banks, final station artwork, full-App Ravine integration, real devices and player comprehension. Runtime availability remains unchanged and Turning Ravine stays unavailable. The dev preview injects only the reference generator into its own zero-command QA route; it is not a normal family selector. Keep that distinction when extending setup/retry behavior.

Local preview helper is `scripts/dev/serve-recovery-app.cjs`, workspace-bounded localhost8755, serving `docs/expeditions/v2/evidence/turning-ravine-20261003/reference-preview.html`. If it survives this turn, it is only a development server. The browser handoff tab is marked for continuation. No existing saved UI winner is overwritten by the independent verification or new screenshots.

Follow-on implementation caution for the new owners: generator seed/placement/domain budget argument validation and canonical dependency fingerprinting still need tightening before production bank use. Do not present the current six raw-ID network variants as eight independent certified patterns. The deliberately bounded unsupported tiers/placement failures stay explicit unknown. No extra generation or station work was started after Sam's overnight ownership change.
